optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Project Manager, Cold Storage Warehouse Automation

professionalSummary.text: Project manager with three years of experience running automation projects for two frozen-goods warehouses under the operator's project method, including installation plans and phased aisle hand-overs.
professionalSummary.witness: Project manager on a cold storage operator's automation programme for three years, running the automation projects for two frozen-goods warehouses under the operator's project method with their installation plans and phased aisle hand-overs.

experienceHighlights.text: Briefed warehouse shift teams on phase changes using the change briefing standard, with 14 signed phase briefing records across two warehouses.
experienceHighlights.witness: Briefed the warehouse shift teams before each phase under the change briefing standard, with the briefing records signed by the shift leads; fourteen phase briefings across the two warehouses.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed automation contractor under works contract, documented 12 defect notices with contractor responses and site instructions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Managed the automation contractor under the works contract on both projects, with the contract records holding the site instructions and the twelve defect notices I issued with the contractor's responses.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared aisle hand-over acceptance packs with warehouse manager acceptance recorded, specifying responsibility boundaries for checks.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the aisle hand-over acceptance packs; the acceptance was the warehouse manager's, recorded on each pack together with which checks were mine and which the warehouse's.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented project boundaries and acceptance test evidence in closure reports signed by contractor and warehouse manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the closure report for each warehouse with the project boundary statement and the acceptance test evidence signed by the automation contractor and the warehouse manager.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes installation plan with phased hand-over schedule, two signed phase briefing records, aisle acceptance pack with manager acceptance, and closure report with repository references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one installation plan with its phased hand-over schedule, two signed phase briefing records, one aisle acceptance pack with the manager's acceptance and one closure report, with the programme repository references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Project management for cold storage warehouse automation projects under operator's project method.
skills.witness: Project manager on a cold storage operator's automation programme for three years, running the automation projects for two frozen-goods warehouses under the operator's project method with their installation plans and phased aisle hand-overs.

role.roleTitle: Project Manager, Cold Storage Warehouse Automation

evidence.text: Project manager on a cold storage operator's automation programme for three years, running the automation projects for two frozen-goods warehouses under the operator's project method with their installation plans and phased aisle hand-overs.

Work sample: one installation plan with its phased hand-over schedule, two signed phase briefing records, one aisle acceptance pack with the manager's acceptance and one closure report, with the programme repository references as a verification trail.
evidence.notes: Supports installation plan and phased hand-over.

evidence.text: Briefed the warehouse shift teams before each phase under the change briefing standard, with the briefing records signed by the shift leads; fourteen phase briefings across the two warehouses.

Interviewer 1 note: asked to brief the panel as a night shift team on a sample phase, the candidate listed the three aisles closing and the dates, showed the new pick route on the layout, named the two tasks the shift would stop doing and the one it would start, and asked the shift lead to repeat the closure dates back.

Managed the automation contractor under the works contract on both projects, with the contract records holding the site instructions and the twelve defect notices I issued with the contractor's responses.
Prepared the aisle hand-over acceptance packs; the acceptance was the warehouse manager's, recorded on each pack together with which checks were mine and which the warehouse's.
Wrote the closure report for each warehouse with the project boundary statement and the acceptance test evidence signed by the automation contractor and the warehouse manager.
